weight: light
tier: 0
charter: C3

Land the step-1 rulings and follow-ups in code (specs/factory-step1-v1/RULINGS.md Q4 and Q6; specs/factory-step1-v1/records/TB5.md "Follow-ups" 1 and 2).

Deliverables:
- (Q4) `factory/bin/revoke-collaborator.sh <handle> <owner>`: dry run by default; `--apply` runs `gh api -X DELETE repos/{repo}/collaborators/{owner}`; refuses (exit 2) to remove an owner listed in CODEOWNERS. `.github/workflows/janitor.yml` wires it as `JANITOR_REVOKE_HOOK`.
- (Q6) `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` mints a token with `actions/create-github-app-token` pinned by commit sha when `vars.FACTORY_APP_ID` is set and `secrets.FACTORY_APP_KEY` exists, else falls back to `GITHUB_TOKEN` and writes a step-summary line saying so. `factory/bin/apply-branch-protection.sh` adds the App as a ruleset bypass actor when `FACTORY_APP_ID` is given (the dry run prints it).
- (Follow-up 2) post-merge's commit carries the trailers `Ticket: post-merge`, `Node: github-actions`, `Assisted-by: none`; factory/RULES.md records that step 3's commit-check needs an exemption rule for that identity.
- (Follow-up 1) janitor's ready duty compares the ids of open (not completed) tickets only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. revoke-collaborator: dry run calls nothing and prints the call; `--apply` makes exactly one DELETE; a CODEOWNERS owner is refused with exit 2. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_revoke.sh, fake gh).
2. apply-branch-protection with FACTORY_APP_ID set prints the App as a bypass actor in the dry run and sends it with `--apply`; without it, the output is unchanged. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_halt_rules.sh).
3. post-merge's commit has the three trailers, parseable by `git interpret-trailers --parse`. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_post_merge.sh).
4. The ready duty compares open ticket ids only: a ticket completing (its id leaving the open set) triggers a recompute, and completed ids never count as part of the set. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_janitor.sh case 'ready-open-only').
5. The workflows are actionlint clean and the App-token action is pinned by a 40-hex commit sha. Verify: `make lint` and `make test` (a grep case).
6. shellcheck -S warning clean. Verify: `make lint`.

Out of scope: creating the GitHub App or setting FACTORY_APP_ID / FACTORY_APP_KEY (Aaron's kit); any write to GitHub.
title: Land the step-1 rulings in code: revoke hook, App-token post-merge, post-merge trailers, open-only ready duty
